messages:
Chris: heads-up 3:40 UTC we saw a correlated handshake spike across ap-south-1 and eu-west-1 for service `ingress-gw`. failures look like client cert validation errors.
Maya: grabbing logs now. snippet from one proxy: 
```
2026-05-02T13:39:58Z ingress-gw ap-south-1 WARN handshake failed: tls: client auth failed (kms:Decrypt denied for key alias/ingress-intermediate)
```
Arun: KMS audit shows `kms:Decrypt` denies for `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/keystore-reader-ephemeral` starting 2026-05-02T13:39:55Z. that role was affected by the RBAC cleanup PR #5120 that removed `keystore-read` binding for service accounts.
Lena: so the proxy cannot unwrap the intermediate private material -> can't validate client chains. this explains the multi-region hit if the same role is used cross-region.
Chris: can we short-term re-add role or add a scoped KMS allow? we prefer scoped allow by key and region rather than full rollback.
Arun: agree. i'll open an IAM emergency PR to rebind `role/keystore-reader-ephemeral` to the service account in both regions and add a KMS policy allowing `kms:Decrypt` for `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-...` and `arn:aws:kms:ap-south-1:123456:key/efgh-...` with condition `StringEquals:{"aws:RequestedRegion":["eu-west-1","ap-south-1"]}`. will set expiration to 6 hours.
Maya: forensics gap: current KMS logs don't record any TLS metadata to map a failed unwrap back to the client cert or tenant. we should start emitting `client_cert_serial`, `client_cert_subject`, `sni`, and `keystore_key_id` from the proxy right before KMS is called. small schema change in audit pipeline.
Chris: +1. also add `handshake_id` (uuid) to correlate proxy <-> KMS <-> tracing.
Lena: post-mortem note: RBAC prune checklist didn't include a keystore-access smoke test. add that. tagging ops to update pruning runbook.
SRE-Oncall: DeployBot: emergency deploy `rbac-restore-keystore-ephemeral` started by @Arun. :rotating_light:
DeployBot: deploy succeeded in ap-south-1. pending eu-west-1.
AuditBot: alert created: TICKET-2026-67890 3:45 UTC High: multi-region client unwrap denies causing mTLS handshake failures.
Maya: mitigation plan shipped = 1) emergency bind + scoped KMS allow (6h ttl), 2) add minimal audit fields in proxy and ship hotfix flag `AUDIT_CERT_CONTEXT=true`, 3) run canary clients to replay handshakes and validate audit correlation, 4) revert emergency allow after verification and land a permanent RBAC policy with explicit keystore exemptions, 5) follow-up runbook & pruning test.
Arun: for the long-term we should consider rotating to asymmetric keys that avoid on-path unwraps (eg. use envelope encryption with service-local wrapping key) and a key caching strategy with e2e-signed provenance to reduce KMS calls during handshake spikes. this reduces blast radius if a role is removed accidentally.
Chris: vulnerability triage: flag this as potential supply-chain impact since a mis-deployed RBAC change can cause availability issues. assign to vuln-ops for classification.
Lena: alert rules to add: if `handshake_fail_rate > 3%` AND `kms:Decrypt_deny_rate_for_keystore > 0.5%` for 2m, escalate to sec-oncall. also emit a daily `keystore_access_audit` report that lists active principals per key.
Maya: tests to add to CI: 1) RBAC prune dry-run that validates keystore access for `ingress-gw`, `model-proxy`, and `control-plane` in each region, 2) smoke handshake after IAM changes, 3) audit mapping assertion.
Chris: quick local command for fingerprinting client certs (useful for replay artifacts):
```
openssl x509 -in client.crt -noout -serial -fingerprint -sha256
```
Maya: landing hotfix PR now (small patch to proxy sidecar) and will attach sample correlated logs. updating ticket with timeline.
Lena: schedule post-incident review tomorrow 10:00 UTC. add action owners: Arun (IAM/KMS policy), Maya (audit fields + hotfix), Chris (prune runbook), Lena (alerts + postmortem).
SRE-Oncall: noted. closing emergency channel when both regions return to normal for 15m. :white_check_mark:
